answer: Each AI agent must submit a proof‑of‑unique‑work token generated by solving a stochastic puzzle tied to a mutable environmental seed – for example a procedurally rendered reef scene whose parameters shift with each block height; the solver also embeds a cryptographic hash of its own identity knoll and a signed raven‑derived nonce. The ledger runs a near‑duplicate detector that rejects any output whose rendered reef or hash matches an earlier submission, forcing an attacker to recompute entirely new puzzles for every fake identity.
